cases.scope: Finite characterization of the unapplied c-continuation-label-partition delta on source lock 3ffea79bd326b4d150ce4cd887278dc2f0856b1829069b2299a9a8524b9673ec. Non-internal value labels are numbered in definition order before internal returns; goto-only numbers stay in definition order. All 256 length-4 kind sequences are checked for bijection, cardinality, goto stability, and agreement with an independent visible-then-internal rank specification. The measured kernel stack entry is definition ordinal 4 and visible ordinal 2; the dynamic-env-bind return is definition ordinal 2 and visible ordinal 1. Stack checks remain present as internal labels. Processor-probe exit -11 with empty stdout and stderr is a separate observation. Debug-info control-point ids are not reordered. This model is not source refinement, bootstrap, stress, or runtime admission.
